title: Faster R-CNN: Towards Real-Time Object Detection with Region Proposal Networks
blurb: Replaced hand-crafted region proposals with a small network on shared convolutional features, making two-stage detection fast and fully learned.
intro: A region proposal network slides over the backbone's feature map, scoring and refining a set of anchor boxes at every position. Its top proposals, after NMS, are cropped from the same features and passed to a second head that classifies and refines them. The steps build anchors, IoU and box encodings, RPN training targets, NMS, RoIAlign and the feature pyramid that later versions add; the capstone turns raw RPN outputs into proposals.
